correctness.rationale: The n shifted side normals are roots of T_n(x)+cos(n phi), yielding numerator 2^{1-n}rho^n(T_n(c/rho)+cos(n phi)). Roots-of-unity product gives denominator |p^n-1|. Differentiation in s=cos(n phi) yields a strictly positive sum because side distances and denominator are positive. At rho<c all angles admissible and minima occur s=-1, maxima s=1; above inradius side endpoints attain zero only in boundary extension. The parity structure of T_n proves A_n(rho) polynomial in rho² and order-n anisotropic coefficient c^n+2^{1-n}>0. n>=3 and 0<rho<1 constraints are stated, and possible degenerate pedal iterates are not claimed geometrically valid.
